title: Shimokitazawa vs Golden Gai: Which Tokyo Neighborhood Should You Visit?
verdict: Shimokitazawa for a full-day neighborhood experience. Golden Gai for one iconic Tokyo night of bar-hopping. Do both in the same day.

categories.name: Nightlife & Bars
categories.summary: Golden Gai has 200+ micro-bars in six alleyways — a unique experience. But very touristy on weekends.

categories.name: Daytime Activities
categories.summary: Shimokitazawa has vintage shops, cafes, live music. Golden Gai is literally closed during the day.

categories.name: Shopping & Vintage
categories.summary: 50+ vintage and thrift stores. Golden Gai has no shopping at all.

categories.name: Live Music
categories.summary: 20+ live music venues, Tokyo's best indie music scene. Golden Gai has none.

categories.name: Food
categories.summary: Excellent curry, ramen, cafes. Golden Gai bars serve only snacks.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: No cover charges, ¥600-900 drinks. Golden Gai adds ¥500-1500 cover per bar.

categories.name: Tourist Factor
categories.summary: Shimokitazawa handles tourism better. Golden Gai overwhelmingly touristy on weekends.

categories.name: Transit
categories.summary: Both 6-10 minutes from Shinjuku. Shimokitazawa by Odakyu; Golden Gai by walking.

faq.question: Should I visit Shimokitazawa or Golden Gai?
faq.answer: Do both — they serve different purposes. Shimokitazawa for daytime/afternoon, Golden Gai for one night after 10pm.

faq.question: How much does Golden Gai cost?
faq.answer: ¥500-1500 cover per bar plus ¥700-1200 per drink. Budget ¥5000-10000 for a night out.

faq.question: Is Shimokitazawa still worth visiting?
faq.answer: Yes — still has Tokyo's best vintage shopping and live music scene despite tourist growth.
